name: Pain de mie

steps.title: Check conditions before preparing
steps.text: At room temperatures of 25°C or above, use water chilled to about 5°C and reduce it by 10 g (mL).

steps.title: Prepare the pan and ingredients
steps.text: Fit the kneading blade firmly on the clean mounting shaft. Add only the initial bread-pan flour and other ingredients in a mound (exclude yeast, all dispenser additions and all ingredients reserved for later) in the centre of the bread pan; pour the water around the edges. Fit and lock the pan in the appliance. Put the yeast in the dry yeast dispenser. Close both lids securely. (Manual p. 18.)

steps.title: Set and start the machine
steps.text: Select program 1, then press Start. Do not open the lid after starting except at a documented manual-addition step.

steps.title: Remove and cool
steps.text: When the machine beeps at completion, press Cancel and unplug. Use dry oven mitts to remove the hot bread pan. Set it on a cloth-covered surface and cool for about 2 minutes, then remove the bread onto a raised wire rack. Check for the kneading blade before cutting. Do not use a knife, fork or chopsticks or touch the underside of the pan. (Manual pp. 18–19.)

notes: At room temperatures of 25°C or above, use water chilled to about 5°C and reduce it by 10 g (mL).
Timer availability is subject to the recipe ingredients and the restrictions on manual pp. 20 and 24; this companion does not choose a delayed start.

steps.title: Check conditions before preparing
steps.text: Results deteriorate at 30°C or above. Do not increase water for Gentle mixing. The machine delay timer is unavailable for this program (manual pp. 8–11, 24).

steps.title: Prepare reserved butter
steps.text: Cut 40 g butter into 1 cm cubes, space apart and wrap or seal. Refrigerate until just before adding. At 25°C or above, freeze overnight for at least 10 hours.

steps.title: Prepare the pan
steps.text: Fit the kneading blade firmly on the clean mounting shaft. Add only the initial bread-pan flour and other ingredients in a mound (exclude yeast, all dispenser additions and all ingredients reserved for later) in the centre of the bread pan; pour the water around the edges. Fit and lock the pan in the appliance. Put the yeast in the dry yeast dispenser. Close both lids securely. (Manual p. 18.) Reserve the 40 g butter for later.

steps.title: Start
steps.text: Select program 15 and press Start.

steps.title: Add reserved butter at the machine beep
steps.text: Open lid, separate and add reserved butter. Do not press Cancel. Within 10 minutes close lid and press Start again.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: When the machine beeps at completion, press Cancel and unplug. Use dry oven mitts to remove the hot bread pan. Set it on a cloth-covered surface and cool for about 2 minutes, then remove the bread onto a raised wire rack. Check for the kneading blade before cutting. Do not use a knife, fork or chopsticks or touch the underside of the pan. (Manual pp. 18–19.) Do not shake vigorously; it may damage the shape.

notes: Results deteriorate at 30°C or above. Do not increase water for Gentle mixing.
If 10 minutes elapse at butter addition, the program restarts automatically. Butter added after this will not mix in; do not add it.
The machine delay timer is unavailable for this program (manual pp. 8–11, 24).

steps.title: Prepare and weigh
steps.text: Fit the kneading blade in the bread pan. Weigh the dough ingredients exactly. At room temperatures of 25°C or above, use cold water (about 5°C). Keep pizza sauce, cheese and toppings reserved for later. [Instruction Manual pp.18, 76; Recipe Book p.36]

steps.title: Load the bread pan and yeast dispenser
steps.text: Put flour and the other dough ingredients, except dry yeast, in a mound at the centre of the bread pan. Pour water around the edges. Fit and lock the pan in the appliance. Put dry yeast in the dry yeast dispenser. Close both lids. [Instruction Manual pp.18, 76]

steps.title: Select dough program d5 and start
steps.text: Use Dough to select d5, then press Start on the bread maker. Confirm here only after you have performed this machine action. The dough cycle is approximately 45 minutes. [Instruction Manual p.76]

steps.title: Respond to the machine’s completion beeps
steps.text: Wait for the bread maker’s beeps. Press Cancel on the machine and remove the dough immediately; it will continue to rise if left in the pan. This website does not detect the beeps. [Instruction Manual p.76]

steps.title: Divide and rest
steps.text: Divide into 2 with a dough scraper and round with the smooth surface outwards. For thinner pizza bases, the recipe permits dividing into 3. Cover with a cloth and rest for 10–20 minutes. [Recipe Book p.36]

steps.title: Shape and top
steps.text: Place on baking parchment and roll into circles about 25 cm across. Prick with a fork. Spread with pizza sauce, arrange the suggested toppings and add the pizza cheese. [Recipe Book p.36]

steps.title: Bake in your oven
steps.text: Bake in a preheated oven at 180–200°C for about 15 minutes. Refrigerate the remaining dough to prevent overproving. Follow your oven’s operating instructions. Confirm completion yourself. [Recipe Book pp.22, 36]

steps.title: Finish and clean
steps.text: After use, unplug the bread maker and allow it to cool before cleaning. Wash the bread pan and kneading blade as directed; do not immerse the appliance body. [Instruction Manual pp.5, 86–87]

notes: The machine makes the dough only. Shaping, resting, topping and baking in a separate oven are required.
The listed toppings are the source’s suggested toppings, not invented substitutions.
The optional three-base division is documented; ingredient quantities remain unchanged.
Machine actions and completion must be confirmed by you.
otherTime: Rest 10–20 min; external oven bake about 15 min at 180–200°C. Hands-on preparation time unspecified.

name: Nogami at Home
notes: The delay timer cannot be used.
At room temperatures of 25°C or above, use cold water (about 5°C) and reduce the water amount by 10 g (mL).
Developed under Nogami’s supervision specifically for Panasonic bread makers. This is different from Nogami’s premium soft white bread recipe; that recipe is not publicly available.
1,263 kcal / loaf
Machine operation follows Instruction Manual pp.18–19, 21–22 and 25.

steps.title: Prepare the bread pan
steps.text: Fit the kneading blade in the bread pan. Add the flour and other bread-pan ingredients, except dry yeast and all reserved additions, in a mound at the centre. Pour water around the edges. Fit and lock the pan into the appliance. Put the dry yeast in the dry yeast dispenser (Instruction Manual p.18).

steps.title: Select the program and settings
steps.text: Select program 2.  Close both lids securely and press Start. Do not use the delay timer.

steps.title: Finish and remove the loaf
steps.text: When baking finishes and the machine beeps, press Cancel and unplug. Always use dry oven mitts. Remove the bread pan, set it on a cloth-covered surface, and let it cool for about 2 minutes. Remove the bread and let it cool on a raised wire rack. Do not touch the pan’s underside or use a knife, fork or chopsticks to remove bread. Check the kneading blade is not inside the loaf before slicing (Instruction Manual p.19).

Fit and lock the pan into the appliance. Put the dry yeast in the dry yeast dispenser (Instruction Manual p.18).

steps.title: Select the program and settings
steps.text: Select program 2. Select Raisin: “Yes ♪ / Gentle mixing”. Do not add extra water for Gentle mixing with Rich pain de mie (Instruction Manual p.25). Close both lids securely and press Start. Do not use the delay timer.

steps.title: When the machine signals the addition
steps.text: Keep the additions reserved until the machine beeps. For Rich pain de mie, the addition alert is approximately 2 hr 5 min–2 hr 15 min after starting. Open the lid, add the reserved ingredients, close the lid and press Start again. Complete the addition within 3 minutes; even without pressing Start, operation resumes automatically after 3 minutes (Instruction Manual p.21).
